4|`id` UUID v4, `title` 1~100자(앞뒤 공백 제거), `description` 0~2000자(앞뒤 공백 제거), `requester` 1~60자(앞뒤 공백 제거), `assignee` 1~60자(앞뒤 공백 제거), `priority` low/medium/high, `status` received/in_progress/completed, `createdAt`/`updatedAt` UTC ISO 8601. 문자열 길이는 Unicode 코드 포인트 기준이다.
5|
6|## 생성
7|요청 필수 필드: title, requester, assignee, priority. description 생략 시 빈 문자열. status는 received. 서버가 id, createdAt, updatedAt을 생성한다. 빈 문자열·공백만 있는 필수 값은 400. 알 수 없는 필드 또는 클라이언트가 전달한 id/status/시각은 400.
8|
9|## 상태 전이
10|- received → in_progress
11|- in_progress → completed
12|- completed → in_progress (재개)
13|- 동일 상태로 변경은 200, 데이터 변화 없음(`updatedAt` 유지)
14|- 그 외 전이는 409 `INVALID_TRANSITION`.

17|`PATCH /api/requests/{id}`는 `assignee`, `priority` 중 하나 이상만 허용한다. `PATCH /api/requests/{id}/status`는 `status`만 허용한다. 수정 시 `updatedAt` 변경; 동일한 값이면 변경하지 않는다. 빈 PATCH 또는 알 수 없는 필드는 400.
18|

20|`GET /api/requests?status=...&priority=...`; 둘 다 선택적으로 사용, 동시에 지정 시 AND. 값이 유효하지 않으면 400. 응답은 `{items:[...],total:N}`. 생성 시각 내림차순, 같으면 ID 오름차순. 모든 필드는 상세와 동일하게 반환한다.

# Spec-Harness Project Sessions (course-style AGENTS.md projects)

## When to Use

- The workspace has an AGENTS.md (or equivalent) that fixes a read-only Baseline, an allowed-write area, a phase order (Specification → Planning → Implementation → Verification → Handoff), and progress.md/handoff.md as cross-session state.
- The user drives one phase per message and expects report-then-wait behavior with explicit standing constraints (no Docker, no /reference, no unsolicited writes).

## Session start

1. Read the harness-named files in the exact order the user lists, with the real read tool — not search/grep. Report each file's line count and a one-line summary.
2. Restore state ONLY from the files (progress.md, handoff.md). Never treat prior-chat content as confirmed state.
3. Report: per-file results, current phase, readiness — then STOP and wait for the next instruction. Do not start the next phase unprompted.

## Standing constraints (every phase, until the user lifts them)

- File create/modify/delete only when explicitly instructed. During review/confirmation turns: zero writes.
- Never run Docker commands — the harness reserves Docker for the user's PowerShell.
- Never access /reference.
- Never self-confirm ambiguous spec items. List them as '해석 필요' with the exact document gap, mark them as requiring user/instructor decision, and keep them unresolved across turns even if not re-mentioned.

## Interpretation items (spec ambiguity review)

When asked to review candidate interpretations against the baseline:
- Re-read the relevant fixed documents with the real read tool in THIS session (citing an earlier session's reading is not evidence).
- For each candidate report a table: related fixed documents + line-level evidence, cross-document conflict (usually 'none — shared gap'), whether AGENTS.md's change-control section makes it an approval-requiring change (a resolution of an undefined value inside the existing contract is NOT a contract change), whether implementation-file edits alone suffice, and a verdict (recommended / needs confirmation).
- Distinguish explicitly: 'this confirms an implementation criterion' vs 'this approves Baseline file changes'. The first does not imply the second.

- Confirmations are table-first and terse; the user re-issues confirmation prompts to verify consistency, so repeated answers must not drift — keep wording stable across repeats.
- Every report ends with a constraints-compliance line and 'waiting for next instruction' (or the user's phrase in their language).
